page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E3.Flex.8-64 is a flexible general-purpose virtual machine configuration based on AMD EPYC 7742 processors. It operates on the x86_64 architecture, providing 8 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs at a nominal clock frequency of 2.25 GHz, supported by 2 threads per core.

The virtual machine is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, matching a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. It includes no hardware graphics acceleration (0 GPUs) and does not come bundled with local storage, meaning primary disk persistence depends entirely on external cloud volumes. One complimentary public IPv4 address is provided with the instance.

Resource allocation represents an economical profile designed for baseline compute and memory density without local drive caching. The 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio suits horizontal business services, application servers, web serving, CI/CD runners, and general back-office workloads that do not demand dedicated local NVMe drives or GPU accelerators.
